# `csharp_place_constructor_initializer_on_same_line`

Keep : base(...) on the constructor's line, or give it its own. Not set, one the author broke stays broken unless a width decides layout.

## Values

| Value | Notes |
|---|---|
| `true` |  |
| `false` |  |

**Default:** `(not set)`

## Conformance

No known case where Curb's output is not a fixed point of `dotnet format` — see [conformance](../../design-principles/conformance.md).

### `csharp_place_constructor_initializer_on_same_line = true`

```ini
csharp_place_constructor_initializer_on_same_line = true
```

::::{tab-set}

:::{tab-item} Before
```csharp
namespace N;

public class Base
{
    public Base(string name) { }
}

public class Widget : Base
{
    public Widget(string name, int value) : base(name)
    {
        Value = value;
    }

    public int Value { get; }
}
```
:::

:::{tab-item} After
```csharp
namespace N;

public class Base
{
    public Base(string name) { }
}

public class Widget : Base
{
    public Widget(string name, int value) : base(name)
    {
        Value = value;
    }

    public int Value { get; }
}
```
:::

::::

### `csharp_place_constructor_initializer_on_same_line = false`

```ini
csharp_place_constructor_initializer_on_same_line = false
```

::::{tab-set}

:::{tab-item} Before
```csharp
namespace N;

public class Base
{
    public Base(string name) { }
}

public class Widget : Base
{
    public Widget(string name, int value) : base(name)
    {
        Value = value;
    }

    public int Value { get; }
}
```
:::

:::{tab-item} After
```csharp
namespace N;

public class Base
{
    public Base(string name) { }
}

public class Widget : Base
{
    public Widget(string name, int value)
        : base(name)
    {
        Value = value;
    }

    public int Value { get; }
}
```
:::
